about: The map editor reference (site/reference/editor.html), read by scripts/gen-reference.mjs. One card per tool or command, grouped by task. Menu paths and keys come from the editor itself (commands.ts labels and menus, Shortcuts.ts key sets): list a card's command ids in `commands` (or an action's `command`) and they're filled in. `where` adds places that aren't menus (a panel, the start screen); `keys` adds keys the old key handler does (arrows, 1-9). --check fails on a card with no description or no location, on an unknown command id, and on a menu command no card covers.

groups.name: Files and projects
groups.intro: Start a map, open one, save it, and bring maps in from other editors.

cards.name: New map
cards.what: Starts a new map: an open-sky room with two spawns per team, ready to build in. If the open map has unsaved changes, it asks first.

cards.name: Open a project
cards.what: Opens a map you saved as a project (.lsmap), with its groups, hidden things and settings as you left them.
cards.good: Your recent maps are listed at the bottom of the File menu and on the start screen.

cards.name: Save and Save as
cards.what: Keeps the map as a project (.lsmap) with everything in it: brushes, entities, groups, hidden and locked things.

actions.name: Save
actions.what: Saves over the project.

actions.name: Save as…
actions.what: Saves under a new name or in a new place.

cards.name: Autosave and recovery
cards.what: The editor saves your work on its own every 3 minutes, and each save keeps the one before. After a crash, the start screen offers the work it kept.
cards.good: Went to the start screen by mistake? Back to (your map's name) takes you straight back.

cards.name: Import a .map
cards.what: Opens a .map from TrenchBroom, Hammer, J.A.C.K. or any GoldSrc editor. TrenchBroom's groups and layers come in as groups.

cards.name: Import from Hammer or J.A.C.K.
cards.what: Opens a Hammer .rmf or a J.A.C.K. .jmf file, with its brushes, entities, groups and visgroups.
where: Start screen › Import from Hammer / J.A.C.K.

cards.name: Export a .map
cards.what: Writes the map as a Valve 220 .map with its texture list, for any GoldSrc compiler or to keep working in TrenchBroom.

cards.name: Project files
cards.what: Lists every file the map uses (models, sprites, sounds and texture files) and where each one is. Copy them into the game or next to the project, or let Find missing files… search a folder you pick.
cards.good: The game won't load a map whose models or sprites are missing, so check here before you share it.

groups.name: Map and settings
groups.intro: Settings that belong to the whole map, and lists of what's in it.

cards.name: Map properties
cards.what: Sets what the whole map is like: its title, the sky and how far players can see, the base light and the sun, the buying and bomb rules, and which texture files (WADs) it uses.
where: Inspect panel, with nothing picked › Map properties…
cards.good: With nothing picked, Inspect shows the sky and the texture files too.

cards.name: Entity definitions
cards.what: Adds a mod's own entity file (FGD) so its entities show up in the entity list with their keys, or goes back to Loner-Strike's own list.

actions.name: Add your own FGD…
actions.what: Adds a mod's FGD next to ours.

actions.name: Use ours only
actions.what: Removes the added ones.

cards.name: Map information
cards.what: Counts what's in the map (brushes, faces and entities) and lists the textures and texture files in use.

cards.name: Entity report
cards.what: Lists every entity in the map. Filter by name or type, tick several to pick or delete them together, or double-click one to fly to it.
where: Inspect panel, with nothing picked › Entity report…

groups.name: Building
groups.intro: The tools on the left of the views, and the commands that change the shape of brushes.

cards.name: Select
cards.what: Click to pick a brush or entity. Drag a face of something picked to push or pull it, or drag across empty space to pick everything in a box.
cards.good: Esc lets go of what's picked. The tool options set whether a box picks what it touches or only what's fully inside.

cards.name: Move, Rotate and Scale
cards.what: Drag the handles in the views to move, turn or stretch what's picked. Hold Shift as you start a move to drag a copy instead (with the Loner-Strike keys Alt does too, as in Unreal; Hammer and TrenchBroom keys keep Alt for snapping).

actions.name: Move
actions.what: Drag the arrows.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.what: Drag the rings; it turns in 15° steps.

actions.name: Scale
actions.what: Drag the handles to stretch.

cards.name: Vertex
cards.what: Drag a corner (yellow), an edge (blue) or a face (purple) of a picked brush to reshape it. The brush always stays convex.
cards.good: Shift-click picks several corners, the arrow keys nudge them, and Merge corners joins them into one.

cards.name: Box
cards.what: Drag on the floor, or on top of a brush, to draw a box brush. Its height is in the tool options above the view.

cards.name: Shape
cards.what: Draws a cylinder, wedge, spike, cone, sphere, arch or torus. Pick the kind and how many sides above the view, then drag.
cards.good: Preview… shows the shape before you draw it.

cards.name: Clip
cards.what: Cuts what's picked along a line: click two points to place the cut, Tab chooses which side stays (or both), and Enter cuts.

cards.name: Measure
cards.what: Drag between two points to see the distance between them, in game units.

cards.name: Hollow
cards.what: Turns a solid brush into a room: walls of the thickness set in Inspect, with the inside empty.

cards.name: Carve
cards.what: Cuts the picked brush out of every brush it overlaps, like cutting a doorway through a wall. The brush you carve with stays.

cards.name: Merge
cards.what: Joins the picked brushes into one convex brush. If they don't make a convex shape together, the new brush fills the gaps between them.

cards.name: Snap to grid
cards.what: Rounds every corner of the picked brushes to the grid and rebuilds them, to fix small gaps and corners just off the grid.

cards.name: Flip
cards.what: Mirrors what's picked along the X, Y or Z axis, around its middle.

cards.name: Turn 90°
cards.what: Turns what's picked a quarter turn around the X, Y or Z axis, around its middle.

cards.name: Transform
cards.what: Moves, turns or stretches what's picked by exact numbers instead of by dragging.

cards.name: Line up and spread out
cards.what: Lines up two or more picked things on their low, middle or high side along an axis, or spreads three or more out evenly.

cards.name: Nudge
cards.what: Moves what's picked one grid step at a time: the arrow keys across, Page Up and Page Down up and down. Each nudge can be undone.

groups.name: Editing
groups.intro: Undo, copy, duplicate and group: the Edit menu's everyday commands.

cards.name: Undo and Redo
cards.what: Steps back through your changes, and forward again.

actions.name: Undo
actions.what: Takes back the last change.

actions.name: Redo
actions.what: Puts it back.

cards.name: Undo history
cards.what: Lists every change you've made. Click a step to go back to it, or click a later one to redo up to there.

cards.name: Cut, Copy and Paste
cards.what: Moves or copies what's picked through the clipboard.

actions.name: Cut
actions.what: Copies it and takes it out of the map.

actions.name: Copy
actions.what: Copies it.

actions.name: Paste
actions.what: Puts the copy in the map.

cards.good: The clipboard holds .map text, so you can copy between maps and to or from other editors.

cards.name: Duplicate
cards.what: Makes a copy of what's picked and picks the copy. Targets get new names so the copy works on its own.

actions.name: Duplicate
actions.what: A copy one grid step over.

actions.name: Duplicate in place
actions.what: A copy right on top, to move next.

actions.name: Duplicate (keep names)
actions.what: A copy with the same target names.

cards.name: Paste special
cards.what: Makes several copies at once: in a row, as stairs, in a ring or in a spiral, each a set distance and turn from the last.

cards.name: Copy and paste in the Inspector
cards.what: Like Unreal's right-click Copy / Paste on a property: right-click a Transform row (Location, Rotation or Turn by, Size, Scale) or the Transform heading to copy it and paste it onto what's picked; right-click a key's field to copy its value and paste it into the same key of every picked entity; right-click an entity's title to copy its properties and paste them onto other entities. Each paste is one undo step.

actions.name: Copy properties
actions.what: The picked entity's keys, but not its class, place, brush model or name.

actions.name: Paste properties
actions.what: Onto every picked entity; keys a class doesn't have are skipped, and a note says which.

actions.name: Copy Transform
actions.what: Location, rotation, size and scale of what's picked.

actions.name: Paste Transform
actions.what: Moves what's picked so its middle is at the copied location, stretches brushes to the copied size, and gives point entities the copied rotation and scale.

where: Inspect panel › right-click a Transform row or heading
Inspect panel › right-click the entity's title
cards.good: The copy goes to the system clipboard as text too, so you can paste a location or a key's value elsewhere.

cards.name: Drop to the floor
cards.what: Moves what's picked straight down until it rests on the top of the brush under it, like Unreal's End. Triggers and other see-through brush entities aren't a floor.

cards.name: Delete
cards.what: Takes what's picked out of the map.

cards.name: Group and Ungroup
cards.what: Keeps brushes and entities together, so a click picks them all.

actions.name: Group
actions.what: Makes what's picked one group.

actions.name: Ungroup
actions.what: Splits it again.

cards.good: Select › Clicks pick single objects lets you pick inside a group without ungrouping it.

cards.name: Tie to entity
cards.what: Makes the picked brushes one brush entity: a func_wall at first, then pick what it should be (a door, a breakable, a trigger…) in Inspect.

cards.name: Move to world
cards.what: Turns brush entities back into plain world brushes.

cards.name: Replace with entity or prefab
cards.what: Swaps each picked thing for another entity or for a prefab, in the same place.

groups.name: Selecting and hiding
groups.intro: Pick things by what they are, find them by name or number, and hide or lock what's in the way.

cards.name: Select all, none or the rest
cards.what: Picks everything you can see, nothing, or everything that isn't picked now.
cards.good: Hidden and locked things are left out.

cards.name: Select the same or what's nearby
cards.what: Grows the selection from what's picked now.

actions.name: Select same texture
actions.what: Every face with the picked texture.

actions.name: Select same type
actions.what: Every entity of the picked kind (or every world brush).

actions.name: Select same name
actions.what: Every entity with the picked one's name (targetname).

actions.name: Select touching
actions.what: Everything touching what's picked.

actions.name: Select inside
actions.what: Everything wholly inside the selection's box.

cards.name: Go to brush or entity number
cards.what: Picks a brush or entity by its number, the way the compiler names them in its messages (Entity 3, Brush 12), and flies to it.

cards.name: Find and replace
cards.what: Finds textures, entity types, key names or values across the map and replaces them, in the whole map or only in what's picked. Pick them selects everything it found.

cards.name: Outline
cards.what: Lists everything in the map by name and type. Search it, sort it, hide or lock a row, and double-click one to fly to it.

cards.name: Hide and show
cards.what: Hides things to work on what's behind them; hidden things stay in the map and still compile.

actions.name: Hide
actions.what: Hides what's picked.

actions.name: Hide everything else
actions.what: Leaves only what's picked.

actions.name: Show everything
actions.what: Brings it all back.

actions.name: Hide all point entities
actions.what: Spawns, lights, sounds and the like.

actions.name: Hide triggers and zones
actions.what: Triggers, buy zones, bomb sites and rescue zones.

cards.name: Lock
cards.what: Locked things can't be picked by a click, so you can't move them by mistake.

actions.name: Lock
actions.what: Locks what's picked.

cards.name: Visgroups
cards.what: Named sets of brushes and entities you can show and hide together, at the top of the Outline.

cards.name: What a click picks
cards.what: Sets whether a click on a grouped brush picks the whole group or just the one object.
where: Tool options (above the views) › Pick groups / Pick objects / Pick brushes
cards.good: Pick brushes (in the tool options) picks single brushes even inside a brush entity, like Hammer's Solids.

groups.name: Texturing
groups.intro: Choose textures, paint them on and line them up.

cards.name: Textures
cards.what: Shows the textures in the map's texture files. Click one to make it the current texture, or double-click to paint it on what's picked.
cards.good: Add texture files (WADs) in Map properties.

cards.name: Apply the current texture
cards.what: Paints the current texture on the picked faces, or on every face of the picked brushes.

cards.name: Texture tool
cards.what: Click a face to pick it (Shift adds more), drag it to slide the texture, and drag the handles to turn or stretch it. Alt-click picks up a face's texture.
cards.good: In the 3D view, right-click paints the current texture on a face, and Alt-right-click paints it and carries the alignment round the corner, like Hammer.

cards.name: Face sheet
cards.what: With faces picked, Inspect shows how their texture lies: shift, scale and turn it, Fit or Justify it, align it to the world or to the face (good for slopes), or pick up a face's texture to reuse.

cards.name: Texture lock
cards.what: Keeps textures in place on the brushes as you move or turn them. Scale lock, beside it, decides what stretching a brush does: on, the textures stretch with it; off, they keep their size and repeat.
where: Tool options (above the views) › Texture lock, Scale lock

groups.name: Entities
groups.intro: Place entities, set their keys and see how they trigger each other.

cards.name: Entity tool
cards.what: Click a surface to place an entity there: a spawn, a light, a weapon or anything in the list. Choose the kind in the tool options first.

cards.name: Inspect
cards.what: A form for what's picked, with help on every key: an entity's name, color, brightness, flags and other keys, or a brush's size, turn and textures. Pick several entities to change them together.
cards.good: A model, sprite or sound key has Choose…, ↗ to show it in the Content Browser, and Use selected.

cards.name: I/O: what triggers what
cards.what: Lists every link between entities (targets, multi_managers, masters and kill targets) and draws them as arrows in the views. Show all of them, only broken ones, or the chain of what's picked.

cards.name: Gameplay
cards.what: Loner-Strike's mode pieces (wave spawners, loot crates, capture points and more), and Mode kits: set Made for to a mode and it lists the markers and pieces that mode needs, with Place for each.

cards.name: Models in place of entity boxes
cards.what: Draws hostages, spawns, weapons and model entities as their models instead of colored boxes.

groups.name: Content and prefabs
groups.intro: Models, sprites, sounds, textures and ready-made pieces to drop into the map.

cards.name: Content Browser
cards.what: Every model, sprite, sound, texture and prefab you can use, from the game, your downloads, Community and your own folder. Drag a tile onto the map to place it.
cards.good: A dropped model becomes a cycler_sprite, a sprite an env_sprite and a sound an ambient_generic.

cards.name: Content drawer
cards.what: Slides the Content Browser up over the bottom panels; Esc or a click elsewhere puts it away.

cards.name: Import your own files
cards.what: Copies your own models, sprites, sounds and texture files into the project's folder, so they go with Playtest, Publish and remixes. Sounds in .mp3, .ogg or .flac become a WAV the game plays well.
where: Drop files from Finder or Explorer on the Content Browser
cards.good: Save the project first: the files go next to it.

cards.name: Prefabs
cards.what: Ready-made pieces (a doorway, stairs, crates, a bombsite kit, a buy zone and more) and your own. Drag one in, or press Place and click; R turns it before you place it.

actions.name: Save what's picked…
actions.what: Makes your own prefab.

actions.name: Share as a package…
actions.what: Saves a prefab as a file to give to someone.

actions.name: Community prefabs…
actions.what: Finds more that others shared.

cards.name: GameBanana
cards.what: Finds models, sprites and sounds to download from GameBanana, with their terms first. Downloads land under Downloaded.

groups.name: Checking and leaks
groups.intro: Find what would stop the map compiling or loading, before it does.

cards.name: Checks
cards.what: Finds broken brushes, missing textures, spawns and files, broken targets, limits, and what a mode still needs, as you build. Click a problem to go to it; most have a one-click fix.

cards.name: Leaks
cards.what: When a compile finds a leak (a gap to the void), a red line runs from an entity out through the hole, and a bar names the brush beside the gap.

actions.name: Go to leak
actions.what: Flies along the line to the hole and picks the brush beside it.

actions.name: Show or hide the leak line
Load pointfile…
actions.what: Loads a leak line (.lin or .pts) from another compile.

cards.good: Close the gap with a brush and compile again. The leak bar also has Pick brushes at the hole and Forget it.

cards.name: Budget
cards.what: Shows how close the map is to the engine's limits (models, sounds, entities, textures and, after a compile, the map's own numbers). Click a bar for what uses the most.
cards.good: Green has room, yellow is over 75%, red over 90%. Playtest and Publish ask first when a bar is red.

groups.name: Compile and playtest
groups.intro: Turn the map into a .bsp and play it with bots.

cards.name: Compile
cards.what: Compiles the map with SDHLT into a .bsp: give it a name, pick Fast, Normal or Final, and press Compile to watch the steps.
cards.good: The first time, the panel offers Download SDHLT (about 3 MB). On a Mac it runs through CrossOver.

cards.name: Playtest
cards.what: Compiles the map, puts it in your game and starts it with bots, using the mode and bots set in the Compile panel.
cards.good: Leave Teach bots the map first ticked so bots know their way round.

cards.name: Cordon
cards.what: Compiles only what's inside the boxes you draw, sealed with sky or black walls, so you can try one part of a big map quickly.

actions.name: Box round picked
actions.what: A box round what's picked.

actions.name: From view
actions.what: A box round what the view shows.

actions.name: Remove all
actions.what: Back to the whole map.

groups.name: Sharing
groups.intro: Package a finished map for others.

cards.name: Publish
cards.what: Packages a compiled map for you to upload to GameBanana, with its files and credits. Compile it into the game first.
cards.good: If a Budget bar is red, it asks first: players may not be able to load the map.

groups.name: View and navigation
groups.intro: Move around the map, arrange the views and the panels, and set up the grid.

cards.name: View layouts
cards.what: How many views you see at once.

actions.name: Single
actions.what: One view.

actions.name: Quad
actions.what: 3D, Top, Front and Side at once, like Hammer.
One big view and three small ones.

actions.name: Two
actions.what: Two views side by side.

cards.name: 3D, Top, Front and Side
cards.what: Sets what the active view shows.

cards.name: Maximize a view
cards.what: Makes the view under the mouse fill the window, and puts it back.

cards.name: Zoom to selection or the whole map
cards.what: Brings what's picked, or the whole map, into every view.

cards.name: Fly or orbit
cards.what: Switches the 3D camera between flying with W A S D and orbiting round what you look at.

cards.name: Camera controls
cards.what: Makes the 3D view move like the editor you know. The editor asks the first time you open it.

actions.name: Move like Unreal
actions.what: Hold right mouse to look and W A S D to fly, scroll for speed; Alt-drag orbits.

actions.name: Move like Blender
actions.what: Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom; F to fly.

actions.name: Move like Hammer
actions.what: Z for mouse-look with W A S D; drag to look, right-drag to move.

cards.name: Camera speed
cards.what: How fast the camera flies. Hold the right mouse button in the 3D view and scroll to change it.
where: Help › Find a command… › Camera faster / Camera slower

cards.name: Camera spots
cards.what: Keep up to nine camera spots and jump back to them: Ctrl (⌘ on a Mac) with a number keeps one, the number alone goes back.

cards.name: Game view
cards.what: Hides the editor's helpers (the grid, target links, effect and track previews, the flat views' crosshair and handles) to see the map as it plays, like Unreal's G. Press it again to bring them back.

cards.name: Grid
cards.what: The grid things snap to as you draw and move them.

actions.name: Smaller grid
actions.what: Halves the grid size.

actions.name: Bigger grid
actions.what: Doubles it.

actions.name: Grid and snapping…
actions.what: Grid size, turn steps and snapping in one place.

cards.name: Snapping
cards.what: Whether new points land on the grid, and on the corners and edges of brushes when you're close to one.

actions.name: Snap to grid on / off
actions.what: Holding Alt flips it while you drag (with the Loner-Strike keys, Alt held as a move starts makes a copy instead, and the copy snaps).

actions.name: Snap to corners and edges on / off

cards.name: Drawing style
cards.what: Draws the active view textured, flat, as a wireframe, or textured with the wireframe on top.
where: The style picker in the view's corner

cards.name: Frame time
cards.what: Shows frames a second and slow frames, for judging how a big map runs in the editor.

cards.name: Panels and layouts
cards.what: Drag a panel's tab to another side, float it, or open it in its own window. A panel layout puts them all back in a set arrangement.

groups.name: Help and keys
groups.intro: Find any command, see every key, and use the keys you're used to.

cards.name: Find a command
cards.what: Type a few letters to find any command, with its key; arrows and Enter run it. Greyed-out ones need something picked first.

cards.name: Keys cheat sheet
cards.what: Every key in the key set you use, on one page you can print.

cards.name: Change keys
cards.what: Switch to Hammer's or TrenchBroom's keys, or set your own. It warns when a key is already taken, and Put back undoes your changes.
cards.good: Picking the Hammer-style keys also switches the views to Quad.

cards.name: Coordinates and axes
cards.what: Explains the map's numbers: Z is up, X east and Y north, the engine's own coordinates.
where: The axes in the corner of a view

cards.name: First map tour
cards.what: Walks you through a first map: draw a room, hollow it, add a light and spawns, then play it. Each step ticks off as you go.
